response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), s AS (SELECT ID, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), m AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.cnt) AS avg_examination_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - m.mean_share) AS avg_share_minus_mean FROM s CROSS JOIN m WHERE s.share > m.mean_share;

assumptions.assumption: Examination rows with a NULL ID, if any, form their own group, as GROUP BY does by default, and are included in the total and the mean.
